summary: Tested Thanoj portfolio backend (6 pytest cases) and frontend e2e via Playwright. All 6 backend tests passed (root, contact CRUD + 422 validation cases, no _id leakage). Frontend: hero headline, sticky navbar, all 5 nav links present, both CTAs smooth-scroll to projects/contact, contact form happy-path submits successfully (form clears, success toast shown), invalid email is blocked by native HTML5 email validation (visible tooltip 'Please include an @'), footer shows year 2026, mobile hamburger menu opens and shows all nav links (verified in screenshot).

issues: Mobile menu nav items do not expose nav-link-<section> data-testid (desktop links do). Visually menu works correctly but automated mobile selectors require generic text selectors. Low priority.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='nav-link-<section>' to mobile menu items as well for testability parity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ContactMessage and ContactMessageCreate both validate min_length=1 which correctly produces 422 for empty fields - good.
server.py: both /api/contact list and /api/status correctly project away _id via {'_id': 0} - no leakage.
server.py: uses os.environ['MONGO_URL']/'DB_NAME' (no defaults) - fails-fast as required.
Pydantic EmailStr requires email-validator; package was installed in the test env. Confirm /app/backend/requirements.txt pins email-validator (or pydantic[email]) for prod deploy.
seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST_-prefixed contact messages via API during tests; not cleaned up (no DELETE endpoint by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_portfolio_api.py covers root + contact CRUD/validation. Public URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL works. data-testids confirmed: hero-cta-primary, hero-cta-secondary, nav-link-{about|projects|experience|education|contact} (desktop only), contact-form, contact-input-{name|email|message}, contact-submit-btn. Mobile menu opens via the X/menu toggle button in navbar.
